items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser that won't strip skin that already looks dry.
A ceramide moisturizer to help comfort and support the look of dry, low-moisture skin.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides helps protect against further darkening of the look of uneven tone and suits deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Please see a dermatologist soon about the cheek mole that has grown and darkened this year, as that is beyond what any shop product should address, and hold off on brightening or exfoliating products until then. In the meantime, cleanse and moisturize morning and night and apply the SPF every morning.
